chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu al-Fadl al-Nahwi, from Abu Ja'far al-Ahwal Muhammad ibn Nu'man, who said:
Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said: If you have prayed four rak'ahs of salat al-layl before the rising of dawn, then complete the prayer whether dawn rises or it has not risen.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ: four units of prayer completed before dawn
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer performed in the late night hours
key_terms.طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ: dawn has risen during the prayer
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ: the rising of dawn marking the start of fajr time

ai.seo_question: If fajr rises after praying four rak'ahs of salat al-layl, should one complete the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat al-layl near the time of fajr. It indicates that if a person has completed four rak'ahs before dawn appears, he should continue and complete the prayer regardless of whether fajr rises during it.
